text:
Ivy: quick design review  thresholds row and preview area. Two decisions: 1) units control  inline micro-dropdown vs tiny toggle (short/verbose). 2) preview chips collapse at narrow widths and overlap the rule label. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/ux/thresholds-compact-overlap.png

Noah: micro-dropdown is explicit and easier to scan. But we can render short form visually (e.g., `5m`) and expose `per 5 minutes` via aria-describedby for screen readers.

Zara: toggle could be nice for dense lists, but needs clear ARIA states. If toggle, use `aria-pressed` and update an offscreen element with the verbose string. Also avoid using placeholder text as the only label for the numeric input.

Kai: mobile issue: when pills wrap they sit over the rule name. Proposal: show first two chips then a "+N more" control that expands a stacked list. The expanded list should be role=list with aria-roledescription='notification channels'. Avoid horizontal scroll.

a11y-bot: Contrast scan: muted-chip text #6C6C6C on white = 3.9. Fails AA for 14px. Recommendation: use neutral-800 (#333333) or semibold 600 at 14px. Add focus-visible outline of 3px when keyboard focused. Also add aria-live polite region for suppression changes that announces: "Suppression enabled  2 channels muted."

Ivy: copy nit: helper currently says "when error rate > 2%"  suggest changing to "when error rate exceeds 2% over 5 minutes" so timeframe is explicit. Also change preview label from "Preview (3)" to "Previewing 3 channels  1 muted".

Noah: UX edge: routing fallbacks are invisible in preview. Show a subtle line: "Primary: Slack (latency)  •  Fallback: Email (on error)" with a small tooltip explaining fallback conditions.

Zara: keyboard flow acceptance: numeric input -> unit control -> suppression toggle -> preview more -> save. Ensure spinner controls on numeric input have accessible names and aria-live updates when values change programmatically.

Kai: implementation detail: keep muted chips in DOM but dim them visually and add `aria-label='Channel X — muted'`. The +N button should have aria-expanded and aria-controls linking to the stacked list id. Log expand events so we can see if users are using the stacked view.

Ivy-bot: Added Figma comments: https://figma.redwood.in/frame/alerting-thresholds-iter5. Action items: Noah to mock dropdown + aria-describedby approach, Zara to mock toggle variant with offscreen verbose text and aria states, Kai to produce mobile stacked +N pattern and expansion aria attributes, Ivy to update microcopy in figma. Target: next design sync Tuesday.

Noah: Will post mocks Monday EOD.

Zara: I'll include accessibility acceptance criteria and example SR labels by Monday.

Kai: I'll upload mobile prototype and add telemetry notes.

Ivy: thanks all :thumbsup:
